title: Document score processor external build and runtime contract
description: Document the public-safe Docker build inputs, runtime environment variables, queue contracts, and permission assumptions required to deploy the score processor outside the Plexus infrastructure pipeline.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Added README documentation for the standalone score processor artifact publisher, including resources created, metadata parameters, configuration variables, validation commands, and deployment command. Documentation intentionally avoids downstream deployment-specific names and account details.
